regions.merged_text: Edw'd T. Shappee 39 was operated on -- "Very Malignant" blood can- cer "tercoma" in Providence Hospital . . . no hope of recovery . . Jan 20th "30. was given ten days to live came and was enrolled . went home and had good meal and slept . . . is here today with wife and 3 children - all in perfect health Deo Gr.

regions.merged_text: "Three years Ago this Fall, Thomas Lucas 66 hopelessly confined to bed with Arthritis was enrolled in S.M.A/ Daughter promised a per- petual enrollment as soon as an improvement were reported ( from Durand, Wis). Next time she heard from Mother the pain had entirely gone and he was around in a wheel-chair. The pain till then fear- ful, .... now sometimes gets along with crutch & cane - not the least pain left

regions.merged_text: Mrs. Jane Glunz (48) has 4 children of 5233 Oregon Ave. dying with pernitious Enemia. Doctor wants $50. Twin sister and her own son are taking blood test To-day, but as yet no one has the $50. We en- roll her To-day 11.45 a.m. instead of going out with relic to visit her. --- Twin sister and other sister Anna Doran promises more frequent Com'ion.
